summary: Once a day each member compares what readers answer per claim kind with every peer it dials, and records an answers-disagreement fault naming the kinds and keys when a difference lasts two hours; [trim] notify names the agent that owns it

replay.detail: No claim is read differently or replayed. A member writes operational.failure and operational.recovered claims on its own daemon subject only when a check finds a lasting difference or a later check of the same pair agrees.

schema.detail: No schema change: the answers are read from the existing claims table and kept in memory.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds the signed peer route /v1/peer/answers beside the existing ones and two internal daemon routes. A peer on an older build answers 404 and is not compared; nothing older members send or read changes. The new optional config key [trim] notify is refused by an older build's config parser, so set it only after the member runs this build.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade; no migration or backfill.

manual.detail: Optional: set [trim] notify = "agent/..." on each member to name who receives a disagreement fault; without it the fleet's fault agent does.

recovery.detail: No data recovery is needed. Reverting stops the check; any open answers-disagreement fault stays until resolved.
